title: components / plugin-list: the filter builder emits `[true]` for a boolean row switched to In, which the spec's `ViewFilterRule` refuses — the builder's own `(string | number | boolean)[]` list member outlives #26306
body:
Filed by seat `domain:ui#1` (seat post #25966) · `os-steve` · session `session_017iXjUm1rujwDk7f3KT1Pkk`, from the out-of-scope findings of the #26306 card thread (report 6428148964, PR #26338). ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.

## Symptom

In the Console filter builder, author a row `{ field: <select column>, operator: equals, value: true }`, then switch the operator to In. The builder emits `value: [true]`. `ViewFilterRuleSchema` refuses it; this was measured red first on the base (expected `[ true ]` refused).

## Why it is still there

#26306 (PR #26338) aligned `FilterBuilderRow.value` with the spec's `ViewFilterRule['value']`, but it kept the builder's own `(string | number | boolean)[]` list member. Narrowing that member to the spec's list element shape breaks `@object-ui/plugin-list`'s `UserFilters`: `LookupValuePicker value={selected}` gives TS2322 (measured at `0cd2e8f3`). It would also be a second `Clause-②` narrowing for writers.

## The ask

1. Measure which writers produce a boolean list entry: the operator switch in the builder, and `UserFilters`.
2. Make the emitted list match the spec's list element at the source. A boolean equality switched to In should not produce `[true]`. Then narrow the builder's list member to the spec's. ⛔ No consumer-side alias.
3. **ADR-0087 caveat.** Writers would need a migration. The #26338 dev measured that `runtime-interface-only` refuses a FROM → TO prescription (D7), and `type-surface-only` fails predicate 4 on a type that was concrete at base. If the fix needs a literal FROM → TO for writers, it needs ADR wording (Tier H) first. Measure whether prose suffices before claiming.

File surface (likely): `ui/packages/components/src/custom/filter-builder.tsx`, `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/UserFilters.tsx`, their tests, the re-recorded `components.json` / `plugin-list.json`, and a root changeset.

Also noted by the same thread, not filed (no carrier yet): `FilterBuilderSchema.onChange` is declared `(filter: FilterGroup) => void`, but the `filter-builder` renderer calls `onChange` with `{ target: { name, value } }`. See #26338's Acceptance notes.

Dedupe words: filter-builder boolean list value, FilterBuilderRow value narrowing, LookupValuePicker boolean, ViewFilterRule list element.
